output.summary: Three independent behaviour tweaks with no code edges between them: cart totals are rounded, the welcome message wording changes, and the default log level moves from debug to info. They look unrelated to one another.

groups.title: cartTotal rounds to cents
groups.description: cartTotal now rounds the sum to two decimals. Check that rounding at this point is intended and that callers do not already round.

groups.title: Default log level becomes info
groups.description: logLevel falls back to 'info' instead of 'debug' when LOG_LEVEL is unset. Check that nothing relies on debug output by default.

groups.title: Welcome message wording changes
groups.description: welcomeMessage now says 'Welcome back' with an exclamation mark. This looks unrelated to the other edits; check any tests or translations that depend on the exact text.
